sketch.name: RailcarFleetTracker
sketch.description: A railcar fleet widget for ethanol shipments: the fleet split by status in one bar you can filter by, totals and overdue cars, a route map, and the unit trains and manifest moves grouped by terminal, with route progress, days out, car count, ETA and expandable car numbers.
sketch.html: Shipments

props.name: statusFilter
props.description: Shows only the shipments of one status; all shows every shipment.

props.name: groupBy
props.description: Groups the list by destination terminal, by origin plant, or not at all.

props.name: selected
props.description: Id of the selected shipment, highlighted in the list and on the map.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Id of the shipment whose car numbers show; empty for none.

props.name: showMap
props.description: Shows the route map beside the list.

props.name: carNumbersShown
props.description: How many car numbers an expanded shipment lists before '+N more'.

props.name: shipments
props.description: Shipments: { id, unitTrain, origin, originLat, originLon, destination, destLat, destLon, cars, status (loading, transit, destination, empty, badorder), progress 0-100, eta, daysOut, expectedDays, carNumbers [] }.

sketch.notes: Simple control (no designer-edited items): shipments are data rows. Fleet totals and overdue cars (daysOut > expectedDays) are computed from the rows. Status colours from the GridKrafter palette (theme colours amber, highlight, green, sky, red). Clicking a status segment or legend entry filters; clicking it again clears. List grouped by destination terminal (or origin plant, or none) with per-group shipment and car totals; the chevron expands a row to its car numbers (first carNumbersShown, then '+N more'). Days-out column: 'Day N of M', red when over. Route map: simplified lower-48 outline in an equirectangular lon/lat projection drawn as SVG (no map library), a curved arc per shipment (dashed while moving, solid when arrived), the train's position on the arc at its progress, plants as hollow pins and terminals as filled labelled pins; clicking an arc or train selects the shipment. Meant for a GridBoard card about 8 columns x 7 rows.
